evals.prompt: Draw the diagrams for this codebase. I've already got architecture.md, flows.md, dependencies.md, and data-model.md in docs/codebase-map/.
evals.expected_output: A diagrams.md with a component flowchart, one sequence diagram per traced flow, a module dependency flowchart, and an ER diagram, all in mermaid, all derived from the existing docs.
assertions: The document is written to docs/codebase-map/diagrams.md
It contains a mermaid flowchart for the components
It contains a mermaid sequenceDiagram for at least one flow
It contains a mermaid erDiagram for the data model
Every edge in the component and dependency diagrams carries a label
Every diagram has a one-line caption
The diagrams are built from the existing docs rather than a fresh crawl

evals.prompt: make me a diagram of how this system fits together
evals.expected_output: A mermaid component diagram with labelled edges, a caption, and a node count that stays readable.
assertions: The output is a fenced mermaid block
Every edge is labelled with a mechanism or an action
The diagram has 15 or fewer nodes
A one-line caption accompanies the diagram

evals.prompt: Diagram the architecture. There are 47 services.
evals.expected_output: A split set of diagrams: a high-level view plus one per sub-area, rather than one unreadable 47-node diagram.
assertions: The output is split into more than one diagram rather than a single 47-node diagram
A high-level or grouped overview diagram is present
No individual diagram exceeds roughly 15 nodes
The response explains why the diagram was split
